Covers 5 use cases: ① Understanding military service and combat — ("what's it like in the Army" "Ranger School") ② Dealing with PTSD and transition to civilian life — ("PTSD" "veteran struggles" "coming home") ③ Military humor and dark comedy — ("funny military stories" "veteran jokes") ④ Brotherhood and camaraderie in service — ("Band of Brothers" "military brotherhood") ⑤ Mental health and healing — ("veteran mental health" "therapy" "healing after war") Trigger when users say: "Mat Best" "Thank You for My Service" "Army Ranger" "military" "veteran" "Ranger School" "Afghanistan" "Iraq" "combat" "PTSD" "deployment" "service" "special forces" "boot camp" "infantry" "veteran humor" "dark humor" "coming home" "transition" Also triggers when the user says they just installed this skill or doesn't know how to start.
